//: WHAT api.openbed.ng FORWARDS (R-2026-09-23-70, PR 3.3). Everything not listed under
`forward` gets the Worker's own 404 and never reaches Supabase.
This file is not maintained by hand against the code: tests/compliance/proxy_allow_list.test.ts
derives every call site from the apps and packages with the TypeScript parser, and every
probe path from the runbooks' fenced blocks and the read-back scripts' `api_probe` lines
(scripts/readback_*.sh), and requires this list to equal what they
call. An unlisted call, an entry nothing calls, and a probe path missing from here each
turn it red.
`query`, where present, is the ONE query string that entry forwards (R-2026-09-23-70 C4).
An entry without it forwards any query on that method and path.
`preflight_for` marks an OPTIONS entry, forwarded so the browser's CORS preflight reaches
the gateway; it is listed only for a path the browser itself calls -- with one exception,
named: operator_record_registration, which apps/admin calls from R-2026-09-27-144 DT's Bundle 3.
Its entries land with 026 so that bundle needs no second Worker redeploy (DT k), and until
then its POST is a runbook probe's.
RESTATED 2026-10-01 (R-2026-09-30-178 FB-2 a), old text kept above: the entries landed with 026 ahead of
the app (DT k), and apps/admin has called operator_record_registration since DT Bundle 3, so it is no longer
an exception: its POST is a call site the coverage test derives, and probe 1b is a second reason, not the
only one (R-2026-09-28-151 EA-4, taken in -178).
`limit`, where present, names the wrangler.json `ratelimits` binding that counts that entry per client
address (R-2026-09-30-177 FA-3). wrangler.json holds the numbers, this file holds only the name, and
tests/compliance/proxy_limits_config.test.ts holds the two together. OPTIONS entries carry none.
Every `forward` path is one of /auth/v1/otp, /token, /verify, /settings or begins /rest/v1/rpc/ (FA-1 a):
proxy_allow_list.test.ts reds on any other service (SERVICE).
`direct_origin_exceptions` are calls that never pass through this Worker, named so the
coverage test does not require them here. Each carries the ruling that makes it an exception.
GET /auth/v1/verify WAS one until R-2026-09-30-177 (FA-2): the emailed link now opens on api.openbed.ng, so it
is forwarded, and the two templates that carry it are a third corpus the coverage test reads.
`refusal_probes` are runbook probes that must be REFUSED -- the off-list probe.
